name: Target Regional Distribution Center Stuarts Draft (T0560)

fieldNotes.truckGate: Fully fenced perimeter (chain-link confirmed in multiple Street-View frames along Mount Vernon Rd). Single controlled vehicular entrance drive off Mount Vernon Rd with Target bullseye monument sign; truck route enters the secured south yard. Not an open site.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth visible at the road entrance in satellite or Street View; entrance is a wide controlled drive without a roadside 1-3-space booth structure. Marked false at medium confidence.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gate control without a visible staffed booth at the road implies kiosk/remote/app check-in at this large RDC; set true. Medium confidence.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Primary dock bank on the long south face; a second dock bank with trailers is visible on the west end face — likely separate ship/receive clusters.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide entrance apron and deep drive with ample paved width to add a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved yard between the fence/gate and the dock doors provides internal queuing room.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Estimated from 1.65M sq ft footprint with dock doors on south and west faces; ~140 is an overhead estimate.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Traced fenced/developed footprint (~53 ac). County/news sources describe a ~110-acre parcel including grassy buffer farmland and a ~38-39-acre building pad (1.65M sq ft, completed 1996).
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property.
